title: Thread system wants graph edges
content: Observation: blackbox threads are encoding relationships to other threads via prose in notes (e.g. "spawned rlhf-countermeasures thread (thread-130aaf11)" in bbox-cleanup's notes, "Origin: bbox-cleanup thread (thread-597b1862)" in rlhf-countermeasures notes). This is ad-hoc edge encoding that wants to be a proper graph relationship. Threads should support typed edges (spawned_from, promoted_to, related_to, blocked_by) as first-class data rather than relying on prose cross-references that only humans/LLMs can parse.
